name: s5-s6-preregistration-a1
title: Power amendment to the S5.3 operational-cost measurement protocol, pinned by the hash of a private document
document_status: private; kept outside the public repository
scope: replaces only the AC-power rule of stage A: AC power is no longer required, a pass needs low power mode off and a starting battery level of at least 40 %, and it is invalidated for power only by low power mode, suspension or a battery level under 15 %; power source and level are recorded for every pass; nothing else of stage A changes
amendments: append-only: a later version is a new document with a new hash, published before it is used
note: The commit that adds this file is the public timestamp: the amendment was fixed before any measurement ran.
